items.note: K.1.1 states the eight-row invocation (y_S += x_S for arbitrary scratch) and the forward/inverse/forward exchange to (-y,x); the substeps reproduce the proof (net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2, three-stage composition) and the neighbour and wire counts, all verbatim from 744-781.

States D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}; the derivation carries the stored-equals-frame-of-logical invariant through edges and gates, using that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, exactly as at 806-822.

Statement complete: nondegenerate labels in F^{otimes 3}, orthogonal neighbouring triple lines, terminal labels, only decreasing edges are central 3->4 losing h, L=Ich, sum Wm-2N+2L, ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The route follows the paper (interstage fit, central labels, side edge 2->5, telescoping, 2L), but the time-by-time gate-label table (eq:motif-labels, 975-988) and residual table (1021-1043) are only summarized, and the claimed orthonormal bases over F_2 are asserted without the nonalternating-space argument of 1073-1102.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, frames Phi_M, endpoint difference I_m, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m; the proof (rank of P_V-P_U equals dim V-dim U, the N rank-one source exceptions 2P_{U_a}, endpoint check P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I) matches 1156-1171.

Phase frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v or inverse per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, C^{otimes m} on every role after Z_{a,k} corrections; substeps follow 1232-1314 (Hamming-weight additivity mod 4, odd-weight basis vectors, the 27-coordinate X_a->Y_a repair, k columns).

L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, and the exponent step (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, exp(-x)>1-x, s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}) are all present. The exact deficit values eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 are never written, so the comparison with 20*2^{-50} is asserted rather than shown, as the paper itself does at 1331.

Both lemmas are stated with their content (digit permutations, digit moves, split/merge, cyclic row split; controlled shift y+a(controls) mod q^b with b^{O(1)} offset preparation and rational units); the claim of S0.2.2 drops the offset-preparation condition but its quote carries it. No proof of 513-550 or 574-639 is reconstructed.

A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular E_i and a rank-a partial permutation, and the shear in exactly a interchanges plus O(V); substeps give the topmost-row/rightmost-pivot elimination, the choice of the prime q, triangular updates in descending order, and the three-update interchange trick, as at 1375-1446.

Row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} on edges via matrix-shear, H<-H+D on every row by the frame identity and contract, three shears to swap, s calls on V/W giving F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and O(e^tau), plus the fixed-tape parking schedule and the one-bit descriptor estimate, all as at 1491-1615.

O(Vu^tau) for any two u-bit chunks; derivation takes rho=O(log e) high digits as the row field, pads rows to a multiple of W^k, splits the width in base m, pads binary ranges to [q^e], and handles widths differing by one bit, matching 1650-1762.

Conjugation by P_M moves kernels to coordinate slots, s_c forward children of C^{otimes f} (inverses via (-i)^f Z C Z), row additions by Gaussian elimination, and H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D, following 1825-1937.

Eight conditional additions flipping a parity, packed cyclic shifts, guard set B with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, chunk-swap rotations, radix-sort repair and the time bound with its o(V) extra terms, all from 2032-2214.

Rows from the first q_0 chunks, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with O(e) leaves below d^beta, internal sum O(e^lambda), leaf bound e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}, base-m partition to O(d^{lambda'}), as at 2286-2441.

Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}; guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with E=64(W+m+1)^3, and the proof's uniform packed-call bound, exact conversion and row-sum argument, matching 2479-2758.

Character cancellation without dividing by zero divisors, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order B_t, reverse traversal for F^+B^{-1}, layout L by prefix-slot moves and K-bit chunk exchanges, rounds as simultaneous layers plus J_E, error sqrt2 ell 2^{-p} and the three cost terms, as at 2812-3201.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four signed products by the established multiplier, centered-residue extraction using |h_j|<B_0/2, negacyclic reduction and truncation to Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)), following 3234-3366.

Two forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise signed-packed products, opposite transform and exact scale by M; normalization via P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v) and error M(3delta+eta)=sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p}, as at 3415-3463.

Costs divided by V=Tp, the seven margins with min 2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional sorting o(V), log factors within p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff, matching 4810-4995; S0.6.5 miscounts the rows it lists as six (see errors).

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: K builds the bit network (K.1.1), frames (K.1.2), labels and the budget Wm-2N+2L with L/N<1/2 (K.1.3-K.1.4), the shear interface with s_b<W_b m (K.1.5), the exponent tau (K.2), matrix shears (K.3) and the recurrence (K.5); S0.3 reuses it through the phase interface for butterfly layers, and S0.4-S0.6 assemble convolution, exact multiplication and the margin 2kappa. Nearly every inference is a verbatim quote at the cited line; the only thinning is in the label tables and the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument (K.1.3-K.1.4) and in the undefined Gaussian maps of the resampling step (S0.5.1).

steps.note: Three stages (forward, inverse, forward) exchange the banks to (-y,x) and restore every scratch wire; m=h^3, N=v^3 with v=C(h,3)=161700, U_a=t_{a1} x t_{a2} x t_{a3} on triples. h=100 is fixed only implicitly through v=161700 and is never written.
One frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, each edge only changes the frame; reused for Phi_M in K.4.3.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{otimes 3} (dimension m), nested labels on every edge, only decreasing edges are central 3->4 each losing h (P x F x Q).
P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are rank-one exceptions where the dimension change is zero.
Sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich via telescoping and 2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with the N extra source ranks.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, hence deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm (and 2N-2L_c for the complex network).
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m for X_a and identity for other roles, so with frames Phi_M every role receives H<-H+D.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per rank-a shear, and the node's recursive calls number the edge-rank sum s.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) by the geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain in the paper's order (network, frames, labels, rank equals dimension change, budget, strict saving, endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, recurrence and exponent), each step carrying its defining formula and verbatim support. The only gap is that h=100 is left implicit in v=161700.
